title: Orthodontic Rider Termination Credits — Premium Billing Accounts Credit Desk
content:
**Scope.** On Premium Billing Accounts, this rule governs the rider credit for an Orthodontic Benefit Riders rider funded by the account that has ended — and only for such a rider. Cascade gives back rider premium billed for months in which the household's orthodontic rider no longer covered anyone.

**When it is due.** The credit is owed once the records show a rider funded by the account in terminated status. It is booked on the account by the agent.

**Business effect.** The credit is recorded on the account's billing ledger as a premium credit on the orthodontic rider product line (the rider line), marked as a termination credit — a rider-line termination credit — dated the booking day, posted against the coverage month of the invoice issued last, carrying the number of coverage months it gives back and the amount; it lowers the account's current balance by that amount, and the account holder sees it on the ledger.

### Booking tool: `book_rider_end_credit_fb22198c`

Agent-side: the agent unlocks `book_rider_end_credit_fb22198c` and calls it. One call records one credit, complete when the receipt returns with the credit's ledger reference.

- `billing_account_id` — the reference number of the premium billing account the credit is booked to, as returned by the billing-account lookup for the customer (identifier).
- `coverage_month` — the coverage month of the invoice the credit is posted against, written YYYY-MM (four-digit year, hyphen, two-digit month), no day part.
- `months_covered` — the number of coverage months the credit gives back, a whole number of months.
- `credit_amount` — the amount credited back, in USD, a positive number with 2 decimal places; a value with more places is rounded half up to the cent when booked.

Receipt fields: `billing_txn_id` (ledger reference of the new credit), `billing_account_id`, `product_line` (always `ortho_rider`), `credit_reason` (always `termination_unearned`), `coverage_month` (YYYY-MM), `months_covered` (integer), `amount` (USD, 2 decimals), `txn_date` (YYYY-MM-DD, booking date) and `balance_due` (USD, 2 decimals, the balance with the credit booked; negative means a credit balance).
